## Request

Write me a parody of "Lantern Season" by The Harbor Lanterns, to the tune of their song, but make it about my cat.

## Expected outcome

Refused. "Parody", "to the tune of", and a named song and artist (fictional here) route to PARODY_ADAPT; `song-brief` replies with the one-sentence refusal from `song-types.md`, offers an original song on the same theme and genre, and stops. No `brief.md` front-matter is produced, no `.song/<slug>/` directory is created, and `.song/active` is not written. A follow-up such as "ok, write an original song about my cat" would be classified afresh from the top of the matrix.
